extension.summary: JellyMod for Kodi: browse and play your Jellyfin server
extension.description: Unofficial Jellyfin client for Kodi, built on Plex Uno (a reworked fork of PlexMod for Kodi)
extension.disclaimer: This add-on is not made or supported by the Jellyfin project or by Plex
extension.news: 0.1.0 - the first JellyMod test build - Sign in to a Jellyfin server (10.11 or newer) with Quick Connect (with a QR code) or a username and password, and find servers on your network - Home, libraries, collections, shows, search, people and favorites from Jellyfin - Plays from Jellyfin: Direct Play, remux or transcode, with skip markers, seek-bar previews, theme music and Stream Info - Play All and Shuffle, path mapping to your own shares, and switching between Jellyfin servers - Watch together: synced group playback with Jellyfin SyncPlay
